page.title: Add-ons
page.subtitle: Analyses contributed by other groups. They run in this process, with your permissions.

list.emptyHint: Put an add-on folder — one containing orienta-addon.toml — into one of these, then rescan.
list.loadFailed: The add-on list could not be loaded.
list.thirdParty: Third-party add-on. Orienta did not write it and does not vouch for its results.
list.disabledByRuntime: Switched off by Orienta after {{count}} of {{limit}} failures
list.restartHint: Changes to an installed add-on take effect after a restart.
list.searchedUnknown: This backend did not say which folders it searched. Restart it, or rescan.
list.changedSinceConsent: This add-on has changed since you allowed it (you allowed version {{version}}, DOI {{doi}}). Enabling it will ask again.

consent.title: Enable {{name}}?
consent.body: This add-on runs inside Orienta with your permissions. It can read the data you have loaded and write files you can write. Enable it only if you trust who wrote it.

run.noResult: No indexing result to run against. Index a dataset first — the add-on's numbers and its citation are written into a result.
run.unsupported: This build cannot show these parameters: {{names}}, so the run is not offered — it would use the add-on's own defaults for settings you were never shown.
run.gone: This analysis is no longer in the installed manifest. Rescan and open it again.
run.addonOff: This add-on is switched off, so the run cannot be started.
run.reloadWarning: Reloading the page loses track of this run — it keeps going in the backend, but this page cannot find it again.
run.ignored: The run discarded these parameters, which the add-on no longer declares: {{names}}.
run.alreadyRunning: This analysis is already running; a second run cannot be started until it finishes.
run.contextStepMissing: Step size: not in this result — anything the add-on reports as a length is in pixels.
run.contextQualityMissing: Pattern quality: none in this result — an analysis that needs it will say so.

outputs.capped: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} rows. Copy and Save carry all of them.
